primary_model_risk: Multiple compression: KLA's cap is ~77x its own reported TTM FCF ($4.01B). Even crediting high-teens growth and 2030 targets in full (bull case, 26x terminal), intrinsic value reaches barely 58% of the current cap. No operating scenario closes the gap - only the market's willingness to keep paying today's multiple does, and that is not an input a DCF can honor.
expectations_gap_key_variable: the FCF multiple: at ~77x trailing FCF the market pays 2030's targeted cash flows at 2026 prices; our base case delivers the growth (high teens near-term, digestion mid-horizon) and still lands ~62% below the current cap
